name: The site's due day is used for every accrued liability
title: SC-07-10-01 The site's due day is used for every accrued liability
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site's due day is 5
When period "2026-11" is accrued
Then every liability of period "2026-11" is due on "2026-11-05"
